title: PairResponse
description: 200 response body from POST /pair (docs/protocol.md section 2). token is shown once here and never retrievable again; the phone stores only sha256(token) in the resulting trusted_peers row (see trusted-peer.json).

token.description: Random 32-byte value, base64url-encoded. Shown once; not recoverable afterward.

scopes.description: Effective scopes after clamping to what the pairing code was minted for.

expires_at.description: Epoch milliseconds, or null for a non-expiring peer token.

mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint on the listener that served the pairing.

events_url.description: Event WebSocket on the listener that served the pairing.

tls_mcp_url.description: Present only when LAN TLS is enabled; the host is a placeholder.

tls_events_url.description: Present only when LAN TLS is enabled; the host is a placeholder.

tls_fingerprint_sha256.description: Present only when LAN TLS is enabled. Compare with the phone UI before trusting it.
